["years three such texts have been published. John Schwaller's book is the most", 'recent addition to this small pool. It is a broad, but concise synthesis aimed at']
['the non-specialist. It focuses primarily on the institutional, political, and', 'economic history of the church in Latin America, providing much detail on']
['shifting church-state relations, ecclesiastical landholding, and the financial', 'practices of various church bodies from the conquest to the present.']
